cron-bot: Scheduled job 'nightly-model-refresh' failed on shard 3 (exit 1). Logs show S3 429 rate-limited. Job id: refresh-2026-03-16-03. Pinged infra. See /jobs/refresh-2026-03-16

Marta L: saw the alert, requeued shard 3, but it's hitting s3 throttle again. Can someone kick a rerun with a backoff?

Ken R: I can rerun with jitter, `rerun-cron --job refresh --shard 3 --retries 3 --backoff 10s`.

Andrew D: thanks. If it continues we should bisect recent changes to model-sync. Any recent uploads? Mihir, you pushed the s3 uploader change yesterday right?

Mihir: yep pushed a change to chunk size. It shouldn't cause more requests per file but will check. Will revert on a test branch if needed.

Marta L: rerun started by Ken at 03:14 UTC. keeping an eye.

cron-bot: rerun finished: partial success. shards 0,1,2 ok; shard 3 failed again -> 429. Retrying with exponential backoff.

Ken R: debug note: saw repeated GetObject with `Range` requests in quick succession from uploader. Could be parallelism too high for small files.

Andrew D: can we throttle the uploader client per-prefix for now? A quick fix is to cap concurrency.

Mihir: adding `max_concurrency=4` on the uploader PR now. Will trigger a smoke run.

Marta L: if that fixes it, we can schedule a full rerun overnight. Also adding a flaky CI test that surfaced in the nightly bench: `bench/kvcache_test.go:TestCacheEvictRace` — might be unrelated but coincides.

Ken R: can someone kick CI rerun for the nightly bench job? I'm seeing 1/120 flakes.

Andrew D: @ci-bot please rerun job `nightly-bench-2026-03-16` --only bench/kvcache_test.go

ci-bot: rerun enqueued by Andrew D. Job id bench-rerun-789.

Marta L: thanks. tagging incident: low-severity, follow up in morning if persists :coffee: 

Mihir: PR posted with concurrency cap, link: https://repo/pull/1423

Ken R: smoke run passed locally for shard 3 after cap. If CI passes rerun, we can declare green and close.

cron-bot: final status (03:40 UTC): model-refresh job succeeded after uploader cap. Nightly bench rerun still pending.

Marta L: leaving note on runbook: add uploader cap as hotfix and schedule proper fix to rate-limit per-prefix in uploader service.

Andrew D: unassigning myself, moving to next on call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
